Use case: stylized-concept
Create ONE original fully HUMAN adventurer illustration for a children's storybook fantasy RPG. The attached 4 images are all the user's OWN artwork and the PRIMARY STYLE reference, not subjects to reproduce literally. Infer how THIS illustrator draws a human. Draw a NEW character concept; do not copy any previous AI-designed character.
Style: non-pixel hand-drawn colored pencil and softly brushed flat color. Warm reddish brown uneven pencil contours with natural pressure variation, occasional doubled contour and confident short hatched shadows. Broad simple rounded face/body shapes with angular chunky hair tufts, large expressive vertical oval eyes with small highlights, tiny nose, warm cheek marks and lively asymmetric mouth. Preserve the quiet, humorous, warm children's-book sensibility of the user's wolves and human portraits. Reinterpret animal tufts into HUMAN hair and animal expressions into HUMAN eyes/eyebrows/mouth, not animal anatomy. The forest original shows how to use scratchy hatching and loose flat color; the portrait gives the tender face; the ensemble gives expressive gestures. Prioritize shape and expression, not just applying a pencil texture to generic anime.
Soft cream, earth tones and muted warm/cool color balance, limited flat shadows and restrained interior grain. No glossy anime gradients or mobile gacha ornament density. Around 3 heads tall, practical modest adventure clothing, strong silhouette, full body centered in square1:1, feet/hair/held objects fully included with 8% breathing margin. ONE character only, THREE-QUARTER FRONT VIEW. Genuine alpha transparency; no paper rectangle, background, floor, oval shadow, halos, diffuse matte, border, text, labels or signature. No pixel grid, dithering, vector-clean lines, 3D render, animal ears, tails, muzzle, companions or extra characters.
NEW character: '木もれ日の冒険者・男の子'. Friendly brave HUMAN boy around 11–13, short dark chocolate-brown tousled hair with a slightly off-center fringe and a single small cowlick, warm dark oval eyes, one brow raised in cheerful determination, open asymmetric grin. Forest-green short practical tunic with ivory rolled sleeves, ocher-yellow short neckerchief, plain tan belt with one small map pouch, rust-brown knee-length shorts, cream socks and soft brown laced boots. A rolled map peeks from a small practical backpack. NO cap, no silver hair, no orange scarf, no blue long coat: make this a fresh design rather than the previous samples.
Action: full-body adventure-ready stepping pose, front knee bent as he turns toward viewer, one hand grips a modest plain short steel sword low by his side pointing outward and safely away from face, other hand holds the small round wooden buckler loosely forward. Both tools are small and simple with broad shapes; character expression remains central. Energetic but not huge special effects. Hair, short scarf and tunic hem follow his turn. The boy feels like he has just spotted the path ahead, warmly courageous, not a grand armored hero.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: ONE landscape background illustration for a children's adventure RPG stage. This is an initial ART SAMPLE, not a first-floor dungeon. User explicitly requested their OWN illustration style, NON-PIXEL.
Primary style references: supplied four drawings are the user's original work. Image 1 forest scene (comic53 2): freely drawn big trees, brushy leaves, rough brown pencil outlines, short diagonal hatching, grass tufts and simple scattered orange/cream flowers. Image 2 wolf chase across green hills (comic53): rounded grassy banks, uneven soft color and warm brown sketch contours. Image 3 tree resting scene (comic53 3): warm tree bark and loosely brushed foliage. Image4 ensemble flyer: warm gentle storybook palette and simple appealing forms. Use the scenery rendering from these references DIRECTLY, not generic detailed anime background painting.
Scene: a sunlit woodland entrance opening onto a small grassy clearing and a gently curving ocher footpath into distant soft green hills. One big friendly rounded tree anchors the LEFT edge, smaller leafy bushes and a low weathered split-rail fence frame the RIGHT edge, a few cream and orange wildflowers and uneven grass tufts near the outer corners. Soft pale blue sky with two simple loosely drawn cream clouds, distant forest in broad muted teal/green shapes. A tiny worn wooden waymarker at far right with NO text or symbols is optional only if unobtrusive. Cozy adventurous late-morning mood, believable playful children's-book world. No buildings required.
Game composition: WIDE HORIZONTAL 16:9 landscape. Side-view RPG battle stage backdrop with eye-level view, NOT top-down map or isometric tile map. Broad quiet grassy clearing occupies central horizontal band and lower-middle, with the ground plane readable for characters to stand on. Keep center x25–75%, y35–75% unobstructed and low-detail for a character/enemy silhouette. Path gently curves away through mid-distance. Trees and colorful accents frame sides without filling center. Clear foreground/midground/distance using broad shapes, not tiny texture everywhere. The LOWER 20% is quiet warm grass for future interface overlay. No literal UI or slots.
Medium: hand-drawn colored-pencil line and softly brushed flat color, reddish brown wavering contours, occasional pencil crosshatching on bark/fence/leaf shadows, light uneven watercolor/pastel fill and warm ivory undertone. Foliage consists of irregular freely brushed masses and a FEW energetic pencil marks, not thousands of precise leaves. Preserve the author's loose, friendly markmaking. No glossy cel-rendered scenery, photorealism, airbrushed volumetric lighting, harsh rim lights, dense ornamental detail, pixel art, visible grid or dithering. No canvas outside the illustration.
Output: complete opaque background art, fill the entire wide canvas. NO characters, people, wolves, animals, enemies, text, lettering, title, watermark, UI, frame or border. No magical glowing particles. A location illustration only.
